themeFallbackDescription: A distinct look for Claude Aura.

chooseThemeFolder: Choose a Claude Aura theme kit folder.
themeAlreadyInstalled: A theme named {0} is already installed.
themeCopyReady: Theme copy is ready to customize.

themeDeleteFailed: The theme could not be deleted. No other themes were changed.
themeLayerImageFailed: The image could not be imported. Choose a supported image smaller than 16 MB.
themeLauncherMarkFailed: The app mark could not be replaced. Choose a static, transparent 96 × 96 PNG smaller than 400 KB.
themeLauncherMarkApplyFailed: The app mark is in your draft, but Windows could not update it everywhere. Try again or restart Aura.
themeEditFailed: That change could not be applied. Review the editor and try again.
noThemes: No Claude Aura themes are available.
gallerySubtitle: Select a theme to apply it right away. Press Escape to close.
customizeDescription: Choose a theme. {0} is currently selected.
themeApplyDescription: {0} Select to apply it right away.
themeSavedMessage: Your choice was saved, but Claude Aura could not show it right now. It will try again the next time Claude loads.
themeNotChangedMessage: That theme could not be applied. Your previous look is still available.
invalidBackgroundMessage: Choose a PNG, JPEG, WebP, GIF, or AVIF image smaller than 16 MB.
removeBackgroundMessage: Claude Aura could not remove the background image.
appearanceNotChangedMessage: Claude Aura could not change the appearance right now.
localeNotChangedMessage: Language couldn't be changed. Your previous language is still active.
studioPreferencesNotSaved: Studio settings couldn't be saved. Try again.
desktopNotFoundMessage: Install the official Claude Desktop app, then try this button again.
continueSigningIn: Continue signing in; Aura will apply automatically.
loadFailed: Claude could not load. Check your connection, then retry.
rescueBody: Aura paused themes and left the real check untouched. Complete it here, continue in your browser, or start a temporary clean Aura session.
rescueRepeatedBody: The browser check returned, so Aura stopped retrying. Continue in your browser, or start a temporary clean Aura session.
rescuePrivateBody: The check also appeared in the temporary clean session. Continue in your browser or retry here later. Your normal Aura sign-in is still untouched.
rescueAccessBody: Aura paused themes and left the real access-denied page untouched. Continue in your browser, start a temporary clean Aura session, or retry.
rescueAccessRepeatedBody: Access was denied again, so Aura stopped retrying. Continue in your browser, or start a temporary clean Aura session.
rescueAccessPrivateBody: Access was also denied in the temporary clean session. Continue in your browser or retry here later. Your normal Aura sign-in is still untouched.
rescueConfirmMessage: Aura will close and reopen in a temporary private session. You will need to sign in again there. Your normal Aura sign-in and profile stay untouched.
rescueBrowserFailedMessage: Aura could not open Claude in your browser. Try the button again or open claude.ai yourself.
reloadRetry: Claude needs to reload. Press Retry.
openedRetry: Claude opened, but the theme needs another try. Press Retry.
startupMessage: Claude Aura could not start its browser window. Install or repair the Microsoft Edge WebView2 Runtime, then try again.
